title: Area 53 Survival Guide
description: Essential tips and information for Area 53 Metal Festival in Leoben.

items.title: Train from Vienna
items.content: The festival is held at VAZ Schladnitz in Leoben. Trains from Vienna take ~2.5 hours.

items.title: Local Shuttle
items.content: Local shuttle buses run from Leoben Hauptbahnhof to the festival grounds every 30 minutes.

items.title: Medical Center
items.content: The on-site Medical Center is located next to the main entrance.

items.title: Cashless System
items.content: Area 53 uses a cashless system. You can top up your wristband at any of the 4 stations.

items.title: Top-up Methods
items.content: Debit and Credit cards are accepted for the initial top-up.
